title: "Info Tech Crash Courses"
subtitle: "Short courses on the things that seem hard until someone explains the basics"

Every course takes 30–50 minutes and has slides, a one-page handout and
exercises. Explainers get tabletop scenarios; builders get a terminal.
Most courses come in English 🇬🇧 and Dutch 🇳🇱.

**New here?** Read [Joining a course](joining.md) · [Meedoen aan een cursus](joining.nl.md):
what to bring, and how to get the exercise sandbox ready in 10 minutes.
